name: visual-prompt-architect
description: Creates reusable infographic, poster, and one-page report templates with 30 presets, empty slots, and mixed text/asset header and footer regions.

interface.longDescription: Builds reusable infographic, poster, and one-page report templates with configurable canvas, background, header, content box, hero slots, child-content slots, and footer slots while preserving user-supplied assets.
defaultPrompt: Create a professional poster prompt from my requirements and reference images.
Design an infographic prompt using A4 portrait unless I specify otherwise.
Review my poster requirements and build the strongest visual direction before writing the final prompt.
